purpose: 32 executions of the actual two-tape MeasuredScan via NativeZipper:source lengths0..8 with zero/one/alternating data,three variable counters,and lengths16/32. Independently generated binary words of numeric counter value minus source length specify expected counter. Exact marked source/counter,both absolute heads and halt checked.
source:
import TransposeFollowup.MeasuredScan
open TransposeFollowup FixedTapeCompiler CopyMachine

def scanMarkedExact (word : Tape Bool) (xs : List Bool) : Bool :=
  decide (word.left.headD .blank=.start) && word.left.tail.all (fun s => decide (s=.blank)) &&
  decide (word.right.take (xs.length+1)=symbols xs++[.stop]) &&
  (word.right.drop (xs.length+1)).all (fun s => decide (s=.blank))
def scanBits (m n : Nat) : List Bool := (List.range m).map (fun j => n.testBit j)
def scanHeads : Fin 2 → Int := ![-7,29]
def measuredScanCheck (xs : List Bool) (m n : Nat) : Bool :=
  let cw:=scanBits m n
  let expected:=scanBits m (n-xs.length)
  let c : NativeZipper.Config (Fin 2) MeasuredScan.Label :=
    ⟨⟨.read,MeasuredScan.bank (Counter.marked xs) cw⟩,scanHeads⟩
  let r:=NativeZipper.run MeasuredScan.program (12*xs.length+4*m+6) c
  decide (r.core.pc=.done) && decide (r.pos 0=scanHeads 0) && decide (r.pos 1=scanHeads 1) &&
    scanMarkedExact (r.core.tapes 0) xs && scanMarkedExact (r.core.tapes 1) expected

def scanPatterns (m : Nat) : List (List Bool) :=
  [List.replicate m false,List.replicate m true,(List.range m).map (fun j => decide (j%2=0))]
def measuredScanTests : List Bool :=
  (List.range 9).flatMap (fun m => (scanPatterns m).map (fun xs => measuredScanCheck xs m (2^m-1)))++
  [measuredScanCheck [false,true,false] 3 5,measuredScanCheck [true,false] 4 9,
    measuredScanCheck (List.replicate 7 true) 8 100,
    measuredScanCheck (List.replicate 16 false) 16 (2^16-1),
    measuredScanCheck ((List.range 32).map (fun j => decide (j%3=0))) 32 (2^32-1)]
#eval (measuredScanTests.count true,measuredScanTests.count false)
